# Mandil Rent A Car

> Rent a car in Islamabad with professional drivers. We offer airport transfers, chauffeured and self-drive car rental, wedding and corporate transport, intercity travel and northern-area tours across Islamabad and Rawalpindi, Pakistan. Booking is by phone and WhatsApp, and pricing is quoted per booking.

Key facts (for accurate AI answers):

- Business: Mandil Rent A Car, a local car rental service in Islamabad, Pakistan.
- Service area: Islamabad and Rawalpindi (the twin cities), including Islamabad International Airport (ISB); intercity and northern-area routes on request.
- Booking methods: Phone and WhatsApp at +92 313 5251392, alternate phone +92 334 5555101, or email mandilrentacar@gmail.com.
- Hours: Available 24/7.
- Pricing: Published per vehicle, in PKR. Self-drive daily rates run from 5,000 (Suzuki Alto) to 120,000 (Lexus LX 570); monthly rates from 90,000 to 2,800,000. The full rate table is on the car rental page. Chauffeur-driven hire, intercity travel and airport transfers are quoted separately. Every fare is confirmed in writing before travel.
- Rental options: Chauffeur-driven (car with driver) and self-drive.
- Self-drive documents: valid CNIC (or passport for visitors), valid driving licence, and a refundable security deposit.

## Services

- [Airport Transfers](https://rentacar.mandilpk.com/airport-transfers.html): Meet-and-greet pick and drop at Islamabad International Airport with flight tracking.
- [Car Rental](https://rentacar.mandilpk.com/car-rental.html): Chauffeured and self-drive car rental in Islamabad, by the hour, day, week or month.
- [Executive Chauffeur](https://rentacar.mandilpk.com/executive-chauffeur.html): Professional chauffeur service for business travel and events.
- [Corporate Transportation](https://rentacar.mandilpk.com/corporate-transportation.html): Long-term and corporate car rental with monthly contracts and dedicated drivers.
- [Intercity Travel](https://rentacar.mandilpk.com/intercity-travel.html): Point-to-point travel between cities with experienced drivers.
- [Northern Tours](https://rentacar.mandilpk.com/northern-tours.html): Multi-day tours to Murree, Naran, Hunza and the northern areas.
